semanticVariability.title: Descriptive Consistency
semanticVariability.subtitle: Quantify how consistent the description of similar purchases is for the same supplier.
semanticVariability.configSubtitle: Choose the institutional grouping and the minimum number of expenditures per supplier.
semanticVariability.disclaimer: Consistency measures administrative record patterns; it does not infer supplier behavior.
semanticVariability.flow1: Lower consistency groups indicate less consistent descriptions.
semanticVariability.flow2: Use the score to prioritize history review and internal standardization.

query.title: Expenditures Search
query.subtitle: Combine structured filters with snippets of the history to locate relevant expenditures. Use history field for specific hints or narrow down by municipality, jurisdiction and creditor.
query.paramsSubtitle: Fill at least one filter or a snippet of the expenditure's history to run the query.
query.historyPlaceholder: Type keywords or paste the expenditure history
query.tipHighlight: History plus targeted filters makes the ranking closer to what you need.
query.tip1: Start with municipality or jurisdiction to narrow the universe.
query.tip2: In the history field, use specific terms: brand, unit, process, or contract number.
query.tip3: Creditor helps when suppliers repeat or a specific bidding is in play.
query.tip4: If results are few, drop one filter and retry; if too many, refine by expense element.
query.tip5: Keep history snippets short (2-6 words) for faster matches.
query.attemptWarn: Fill at least one filter or the history field to execute the query.
query.noResults: Query returned zero items. Adjust your filters and try again.
query.pendingPanel: Results will appear here as soon as a query is executed.

fractionation.title: Split-Purchases Analysis
fractionation.subtitle: Combine municipality, jurisdiction and year to reveal suspicious clusters. The filters support in-depth analysis through charts and time series.
fractionation.configSubtitle: Start by choosing the municipality; this unlocks the jurisdiction list and organizes the next filters.
fractionation.flow1: Explore suspicious clusters before opening expenditures.
fractionation.flow2: Inside a cluster, charts and stats help you decide where to focus.
fractionation.tableSubtitleGroups: Select a group to detail the component expenditures.
fractionation.noRecords: No records found for the chosen filters.

overpricing.title: Overpricing Analysis
overpricing.subtitle: Combine a year and a description from the history to run the overpricing check. The result provides comparison with the reference group, LLM filter and supporting charts.
overpricing.configSubtitle: Use clear terms like “fornecimento de água mineral”. The algorithm searches for similar expenditures and evaluates the group.
overpricing.flow1: We search for expenditures with similar history and build the reference group.
overpricing.flow2: We apply statistical cuts and the LLM filter (when available) to prioritize suspects.
